scenarios.name: Primary + DR with overlapping work

acceptance: DR starts preparing before Primary completes where permitted; only milestones gate it
PVWA/CPM/PSM proceed while DR waits; no global completion barrier
Fresh PADR cycle, metadata and replicated test Safe observed, not just service Running
DR wait emits phase/elapsed/max progress, including heartbeat during long waits
No false success for DR if its last acceptance check is still Running

scenarios.name: Verification interruption and exact-once action recovery
faults: After PSMP hardening action is durably Succeeded, interrupt only its read-only verification worker or controller observation
Separately interrupt staging BEFORE worker claim; never kill a worker just to test retry
Restore transport; Resume-PASRun without destructive RetryStep
acceptance: Action attempt ID remains unchanged after recovery
Verifier generation changes only after old verifier has a valid PID+boot identity and is provably inactive
No second hardening or installer action is dispatched
If initializer/claim provenance is missing, run stays Unknown and does not autonomously spawn another verifier
Read-only verifier completes and PSMP transitions to Succeeded with preserved attempt history

scenarios.name: Unrelated failure isolation and later recovery
scenarios.placement: Independent Linux targets for PTA and PSMP; other roles separated or PVWA+CPM

acceptance: PTA failure is visible and does not stop Primary, DR, PVWA, CPM, PSM or PSMP

On resume, successful lanes are reverified, not replayed as mutations

scenarios.name: Forced controller stop and remote lock safety
scenarios.entrypoint: CLI Parallel; -Force controlled abort only after observing live remote worker
faults: Stop-PASRun -Force during an executing detached action
Attempt a new run against the same target before reset
Restore all touched VMs to immutable golden snapshots, then explicitly release old locks with credentials
acceptance: Old run recorded Abandoned; no false claim that remote processes exited
New deployment blocked by retained target locks despite controller having stopped
No old detached worker remains after VM restoration
Locks are released only with explicit ReleaseLocksAfterReset after actual VM reset
Clean new deployment can start; evidence includes before/after VM snapshot identities and lock owner IDs
